bugs.title: Heartbeat stalls during blocking chime pulse
bugs.description: pulseChimeBlocking() calls delay(CHIME_MS) at line 27, which blocks the loop for 1800 ms, so the heartbeat check at lines 57-62 cannot run during the pulse. Measured evidence shows gaps of 2000 ms and 1900 ms between 'gate-hb' lines, far outside the 300 ± 100 ms requirement. Expected /^gate-hb$/ every 300 ± 100 ms; 5 of 8 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 2000 ms.

bugs.title: Firmware silent for 1800 ms during chime
bugs.description: The blocking delay(CHIME_MS) at line 27 halts all serial output and pin activity for the full 1800 ms pulse, exceeding the 700 ms silence limit. Measured evidence reports 'no activity for 1800 ms' repeatedly across scenarios. Firmware went silent for 1800 ms with no serial output or pin activity (limit 700 ms); 5 such gap(s).
